name: Central Town Floods

npcs.name: Nurse Joy
dialogue: After the fire, earthquake, and typhoon, runoff is rushing through town and covering the low street.
Take the raised road to the school shelter. Never enter the floodwater, on foot or by car.
after_dialogue: We reached the school by the high road. The water can hide open drains and debris.
rescue_dialogue: I am helping neighbors and need drinking water before I can make the move to high ground.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can leave for the safe area with you now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the water, then talk to me again.

choice.prompt: Floodwater covers the direct street route. Which way?

options.text: Take the raised road to the school
options.result: The team stays out of floodwater.
options.consequence: You kept the group out of floodwater.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.result: Floodwater can hide hazards and carry people away.
options.consequence: You sent the group through floodwater.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

quests.title: Find a first-aid kit for the evacuation to high ground.

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.community: Find Nurse Joy and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach High Ground / School and stay clear of danger.

lessons: Never walk or drive through floodwater; depth and current can be hard to judge.
Move to higher ground and follow local evacuation instructions.
Keep emergency supplies and a family communication plan ready.

quiz.question: Floodwater covers your planned route. What should you do?
options: Turn around and use a safe route directed by local authorities
Walk through if it looks shallow
Follow a vehicle through the water
quiz.explanation: Floodwater depth and current are difficult to judge. Never walk or drive through it.

briefing: Heavy rain and blocked drainage push water through low streets. Keep residents away from floodwater and electrical hazards, find a safe route to higher ground, and restore communications from an accessible emergency point.
story_clue: A harbor worker reports that coastal water and weather are behaving unpredictably.
